notes.title: Dark Hours Regular Update #51: New Map Rotation & Optimization Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,



A new regular update for Dark Hours is now live! In this update, we’re introducing a new rotation of maps for all game environments except the recently added Cruise Ship. This means you’ll now have the opportunity to explore 8 new maps for the Auction House, Museum, Casino, and Power Plant. Let’s start a new heist night!



In addition, we’ve been working hard to fix performance and optimization issues you’ve reported over the past few days. While improvements are added to this update, we will continue investigating these issues in the coming days—more improvements are on the way.



You can read the complete patch notes just below 🔽



Have fun!
Raven



🔔 Stay updated on all things Dark Hours:

 Discord Tiktok Bluesky Twitter Instagram 

Or contact us at contact@darkhours-thegame.com




Patchnote #51 for Dark Hours (v0.10.21386) - 26/08/2025Monster
Driftborn Movement Fix: Fixed a bug where the Driftborn stopped moving when a player opened a door.



Salt Driftborn Fix: Fixed a bug where the Driftborn didn’t react to a player throwing a salt shaker at it 



SFX Driftborn & Salt:Added a reaction SFX for the Driftborn when hit by salt



Driftborn Dissolve Fix: Fixed a bug where the Driftborn could trigger its dissolve effect for no apparent reason 



Monster Overlap Dynamic Modifie: This option has been adjusted to improve in-game performance

Gameplay
Washing Machine NEW: You can now put your allies in a machine and give them a proper cleaning

LD
Environment Seeds Modified: Replaced the seeds for Auction House, Museum, Casino, and Power Plant


Toilet Cabin Fix: Fixed the toilet booth collider to prevent players from crawling next to it


Display Case Cruise Ship Fix: Fixed a display case that spawned too close to the stairs


Laser Vault Fix: Fixed a bug where a laser could sometimes be embedded in a pillar in the cruise ship vault mini-game


Sofa Cruise Ship Fix: Fixed a bug where sofas were spawning lower than they should


Trashcan Fix: Fixed a bug where trashcans could block monster navigation

General
Van Cinematique Fix: Fixed a bug where clients only saw a wheel instead of the van in the intro cinematic


Electrocuted Animation Fix: The electrocution animation stopped while the electrocution effect was still ongoing


Missing Rain in Casino Fix: Fixed a bug where the rain in the casino patio could sometimes be missing

Known Bugs:
Performance issues in Cruise Ships are still under investigation.

notes.title: Dark Hours: Cruise into Madness Major Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,


Dark Hours: Cruise into Madness, is officially available!


Step aboard the haunted cruise ship, face the terrifying Driftborn, push your limits with the brand-new Nightmare Difficulty and more! 

💡 Find the full patchnote at the bottom of this news



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/074af58b7ccc53bde7024ef96346d028f3d51db2.png"]




[previewyoutube="oJE0fI0EWBA;full"][/previewyoutube]



🚢 Explore the Haunted Cruise Ship
Welcome aboard: stroll through tight corridors, relax on the main deck, take a nap in the captain’s quarters or check out the engine room. This cruise is one you won’t forget… if you make it out.


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/6ecc03c1dc429f558d3029fe2a5f2c21f6b36c16.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/72ddc04cb01e35442333d6cf998d838da8ede0e8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/7091aaf937fabcbf3d8bebc9411bbeb91a0b133a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/61b17862e1bc57eb7be56662634283ab8d8bf763.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/8a0bedd9d1e3bd9cd3bdca61d20236d90192a455.png"][/carousel]

🐙 Meet the Driftborn — Your New Worst Nightmare
Something ancient has awakened aboard the cruise ship... A terrifying tentacled beast lurking in the shadows — and it’s not happy you’re here. Do you think you can survive it?



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/3fb7bfef9a55e645c18dd71a9f5a3a4f61ecca5c.gif"]




💀 Nightmare Difficulty — The Challenge You’ve Been Waiting For
Our most demanding difficulty is finally here! Face multiple monsters at once and test your teamwork and survival skills like never before. Good luck — you’re going to need it.


[previewyoutube="XygTVD5h5pg;full"][/previewyoutube]



🎒 New Themed Customization — Cruise & Sea Style
Show off your style with fresh cruise-inspired items. The octopus backpack is already stealing the show. 


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/1a4dd06b02105e1f8814b390a3f78fd88e1ff38c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/8819296a9ba11041f557ae517e15de7e04e6a0eb.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/de132db91b08002c3e3359c94b52c819a9b74bd0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/4b627289286fa79200fb84764043404716587b89.png"][/carousel]

🚐 Customize Your Van!
Your getaway vehicle just got a makeover! Change colors or completely transform the look of your van — who’s ready for a heist night in an ice cream truck?


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/d7494de1a67a8527f065885f27faf1f9524692ae.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/6eccaedfb5f5537e7aed17f280f2de6c3f04b976.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/d0b4b2c2423312607ec464e90150798ef60f494f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/acfa5a1507e09cba292423c66202b217c0260521.png"][/carousel]

🔄 Rejoin Feature — Stay in the Action
Got disconnected during your heist? Not a problem anymore! You can now rejoin ongoing games and jump straight back into the chaos.




🕹️ New Vault Minigame — Cooperation Required
New environment, new minigame! Get ready to work together and disable tricky new laser traps to crack open the vault. Teamwork has never been so crucial.




🔨Bug fix & improvements
As with every update, we’ve taken the opportunity to fix bugs you’ve reported. Scroll down for the full patchnote.





Ready to dive in?

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208570/Dark_Hours/"][/dynamiclink]

We can’t wait to hear what you think! Feel free to share your feedbacks on on our Discord or directly on the Steam forums. 



See you on board! 

Raven



🔔 Stay updated on all things Dark Hours:

 Discord Tiktok Bluesky Twitter Instagram 

Or contact us at contact@darkhours-thegame.com

notes.title: Sign Up Now for the Next Major Update Playtest – Opens This Friday!
notes.notes:
Hello burglars!


We hope you're enjoying your summer — maybe even taking some time off, soaking up the sun... or relaxing somewhere peaceful?



Well, it’s time to get back to work — because this weekend, we’re kicking off a brand-new playtest to give you an exclusive first look at the next major update of Dark Hours: Cruise into Madness. And it just so happens to take place in the perfect summer setting: a haunted cruise ship 🚢



Ready to explore this new environment and come face-to-face with the new monster lurking onboard?

Sign up now to be notified as soon as the playtest opens — and keep your eyes peeled for a few extra surprises. Maybe even a chance to test the new Nightmare Mode? Just saying...



🗓️ The playtest will run from Friday through Monday.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/61d032d97ec3888df51f652d1fdb1194cf8b4b25.png"]


I want to join, how can I sign up?
It’s super easy: 

Head over to Dark Hours Steam page. If you haven’t already signed up for a previous playtest, just click on Request Access to join. Once that’s done, you’ll be added to the list of players eligible to participate. You’ll be able to download the playtest as soon as access opens this Friday!  



Don’t own Dark Hours? No worries — you can still take part!    

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208570/Dark_Hours/"][/dynamiclink]



We’ll also be posting an announcement on Friday to mark the official launch of the playtest. We’re excited to hear your feedback — and to see how long you’ll survive aboard the ship.



See you on board! 

Raven



🔔 Don’t want to miss the latest about Dark Hours? Follow us: 

 Discord Tiktok Bluesky Twitter Instagram
Or contact us at contact@darkhours-thegame.com

Patchnote #45 for Dark Hours (v0.9.20280) - 27/06/2025Gameplay
Sled KO Fix: Fixed a bug where a player carried on a sled would move erratically in a single direction if they were knocked out mid-ride.


Catch Animation Fix: Fixed an issue where the catch animation wouldn't play when grabbing a player crouching under a vent grille.


Objective Item Spawn Logic: Objective-related items will now avoid spawning in the same room whenever possible.


Loot Share Fix: Fixed a bug where looting items from a dead player’s bag would incorrectly remove the recovered money from the group’s shared stash.


Loot Item Respawn Fix: Fixed an issue where some loot items would remain static and respawn at their original location after being thrown.


Score Contract Coefficient Fix: Fixed the score contract coefficient to prevent loot items from spawning repeatedly in the same room in Easy mode.



Push Fix: Fixed an issue where players could push others while unfreezing them.



Code Door Unlock Fix: Fixed a bug where the door linked to the paper code wouldn’t open after successfully completing the minigame. 


Monsters
Mummy Fix: Fixed a bug where the Mummy could become stuck when casting Cursed Mark near a crossed door.


Banshee Fix: Fixed an issue where the Banshee’s screamer wasn’t correctly oriented based on the position of the triggering player.


Stone Stalkers Fix: Fixed a bug where Stone Stalkers could move at the edge of the player’s vision.


Vault Entrance Navigation Fix: Fixed a bug where monsters had trouble entering the Vault room in the Auction House.

UI
Lobby Rejection Message Update: The error message displayed when being rejected from a lobby has been made slightly more informative.

LD
Fuse Box Door Fix: Fixed an issue where fuse box or lever doors would close automatically if opened from the inside and the power source (fuse or lever) was removed.


Trash Spawning Fix: Fixed a bug causing trash to spawn incorrectly in the Casino Vault.



Paper Code Spawn Fix: Fixed an issue where the paper code could spawn beneath the sidewalk in the staff parking lot (Casino), making it nearly invisible.

General
Gramophone Trigger Fix: Fixed a bug where the gramophone music could start playing randomly, even when its trigger event wasn’t active. 


Self Flashlight Visibility On Player: Improved flashlight behavior to illuminate the player’s surroundings, making nearby characters slightly visible even in complete darkness.


Glass Refraction Fix: Fixed an issue where certain glass surfaces distorted the background incorrectly due to faulty refraction rendering.



Glass VFX Update: Updated the visual effects system for broken glass.


Summer Cosmetics Added: New character customizations themed around summer have been added.

 - Stone Stalkers are now correctly immobile when they are positioned one behind the other.

Gameplay

Doors Fix: You can now open doors from the inside if you managed to enter through a vent or if one of your teammates locked you in.
Electric doors locked fix: A door requiring electricity or hacking device can now also be opened from the inside but will close again once the player moves away from it.
Defibrillator fix: Fixed a bug where a player put to sleep by a tranquilizer dart and revived by a defibrillator would retain the dart's effects (slowed voice, snoring, black vignette) when they should not.

LD

Items spawn in the starting room: Defibrillator & extinguisher can no longer spawn in the first room to prevent potential softlocks.
Room Name: The room name is now displayed on both sides of the doors.  
Van windows: Applied the rain shader to the van's windows.
Museum Improvement:
 - Mammoth Skeletons collision Fix: Fixed the collision preset of the mammoth skeleton, which could prevent the statues from properly seeing the player.
 - Museum pillar collision Fix: To prevent any softlocks, it is no longer possible to throw objects on top of the pillars in the museum.
 - Shelves collider in museum's restoration rooms fix: It is now possible to crouch under the shelves in the restoration room.
Room Name: The room name is now displayed on both sides of the doors.  
Van windows: Applied the rain shader to the van's windows.
Door sound: Adjusted the sound produced by doors when opening and closing, which could impact the behavior of the Blind Ghoul.

Interface

notes.title: The Cursed Pharaoh Major Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce that The Cursed Pharaoh Update for Dark Hours is now available for everyone!
This major update brings plenty of new content, including planned features, highly requested features from the community, and a few surprises!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120298/99bab9e35ea4b9a2f9a4d1d270ec26429f1b12f8.png

What you’ve been waiting for

 🔪 An ancient slasher comes to hunt you: The Mummy
Get ready to be chased by a brand-new creature: the Mummy. This terrifying monster loves watching you and slowly closing in to impale you with its blade!

🏛 Want to pull off a heist in a Museum, right? Let's go! 
What better place than a Museum to line your pockets? A brand-new heist environment, The Museum, is now available to explore. Enjoy a set of 16 different layouts to make each of your heists unique! Time to plan your next big score!

[previewyoutube=FlmpukPv6IA;full][/previewyoutube]

But also

👋Say hello to the newest member of the team
The boss wanted to strengthen our crew. So he brought in this new recruit. Consider them one of us! You now have the choice between two types of burglars!

🤝Quickplay feature
Assemble a team of professional burglars faster than the speed of light! By popular demand, we’ve added a quick matchmaking system to make it easier to form groups.
Note: The servers will be active starting tomorrow.

🎒Stay stylish while you steal!
Wanted to switch up your backpack? This update is for you! You can now customize your backpacks!

🧯Discover new playable items!
While we already had a hairdryer and a foghorn, what else could we possibly add to the game? Well, it’s simple:

 Coffee: Grab a cup, place it in the coffee machine, and enjoy a nice hot brew!
 Extinguisher: What could you possibly do with this during a heist? I’ll let you figure that out!
 Defibrillator: You can now revive a teammate who died too soon. Just be careful—it’s charged with electricity, so don’t shock someone who’s still alive!

🙋‍♀️Allo? Allo??
You wanted a way to communicate in the game without micro, and now it’s here! Check out our brand-new tag feature and fresh emotes. 

🏃🏿‍♂️ Golden Tag game mode?
But what's the "Golden Tag"? We wanted to introduce a lighter, more fun game mode to play between heists! Your goal is to keep the title for as long as possible! Your opponents can take it from you by pushing you. Anything goes.

🎮Some Improvements
We’ve improved the keybinding interface to make it smoother and more user-friendly! To prevent you from getting completely stuck when choosing contracts, we’ve also added a countdown! Other minor improvements have also been made based on your feedback!


🎇And what's next?
This update will be the last major one for 2024, but it’s definitely not the last we have planned for Dark Hours!. Starting in 2025. more updates are planned so get ready for more features to come! 

As always, we can’t wait to hear your feedback. Feel free to share it on the Steam forums, on Discord, or directly via email. 

We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed designing and developing it! We can't wait to hear all about how your heists went!


Dark Hours Steam page 🔽

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208570/Dark_Hours/


Have fun! 

Raven

notes.title: When is the Early Access release of Dark Hours?
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

First off, I want to thank you all for the amazing support and excitement you show for Dark Hours. We’re so happy to have such a passionate community by our side. 

Now, let’s talk about what you’ve all been waiting for! 
When is the Early Access release?


We know we’ve been quiet lately, and many of you have been asking about the Early Access release date. Today, I’d like to share some insights on the development of Dark Hours over the past few months. 

When we began working on Dark Hours, all we wanted was to create a fun co-op horror game to enjoy with friends, and we didn’t expect such an amazing reaction from you all. The enthusiasm you’ve shown for the game has been incredible — more than 2 millions downloads for the demo and the prologue as I’m writing these lines… mind-blowing! — and your excitement to see more is beyond what we ever dreamed of.

With so many players on board, we definitely feel the pressure now. As the saying goes, with great power comes great responsibility, and we’re aware of the high expectations for the Early Access release. Gosh, this is challenging, but we’re dedicated to meeting those expectations and offering you a truly unique and fun co-op heist-horror experience that lives up to your excitement.


That’s why we’ve taken the time to read all your messages, comments and feedback, and to respond as much as we can on the Steam forums and our Discord (and yes, it takes time!). We’re also actively working on many new features that we want to have ready for Early Access, including:

 New scary monsters
 Difficulty levels from Easy to Nightmare
 Customization options like colors and items
 Procedurally generated maps - which is not so easy to implement 😅
 An improved gameplay loop to immerse you even more into your heist night
 New missions other than stealing the Royal Crown
 New gameplay items, and fun gameplay features
 … and other cool stuff I might have missed!
 All this to ensure we can bring you the best possible experience for you and your friends.


So, we’ve decided to reschedule the Early Access launch to the end of October.

This extra time will allow us to add and polish all these exciting new features you’ve been asking for.
We know the wait is going to be a bit longer than expected, please bear with us!


Important info:

📅 The exact release date and the official price tag will be revealed on October 9, so stay tuned! 📅

Follow us on Steam and our social media to stay up-to-date with the latest news about Dark Hours and the release date reveal! You can also join our Discord server.

Discord Tiktok Twitter Instagram
 
 

Stay tuned and keep the lights on. Dark Hours is coming, and your wait will be worth it!

Raven
